verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway logs every MCP call routed through it and says this lets you 'know exactly what your AI is doing', which is a first-party foundation for call-level visibility on hosted and gateway-fronted servers. The evidence shows no analytics view that aggregates that data. missing for 10: documented usage dashboards or aggregated call-volume metrics, per-user breakdowns, error-rate reporting, cost attribution, org-level analytics for published servers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost

citations.quote: Every MCP call from your agents flows through Glama – so you know exactly what your AI is doing
Every call through this URL is logged, access-controlled, and credential-managed
Deploy any server from the registry to Glama and we automatically put the Gateway in front of it.
